map.由质量、线速度与曲率半径，按 F = mv²/r 计算匀速圆周运动所需向心力。: Compute the centripetal force needed for uniform circular motion from mass, linear speed and radius with F = mv²/r.
map.向心力指向圆心，由合外力提供；并非独立新力。: Centripetal force points to the center and is provided by the net external force; it is not an independent new force.
map.匀速圆周运动的向心合力。: The net centripetal force in uniform circular motion.
map.估算车辆转弯或旋转机械所需向心力，用于结构强度校核。: Estimate the centripetal force needed for vehicle cornering or rotating machinery, used for structural strength checks.
map.向心力从哪来？: Where does centripetal force come from?
map.由张力/重力/摩擦力等提供，方向始终指向圆心。: Provided by tension, gravity, friction, etc., always directed toward the center.
map.在惯性参考系中不存在，那是转动参考系中的惯性效应。: It does not exist in an inertial frame; it is an inertial effect in a rotating reference frame.
map.向心力：F = m·v² ÷ r（N）；联动量：千克力口径 = F ÷ 9.80: Centripetal force: F = m·v² ÷ r (N); linked values: kilogram-force = F ÷ 9.80665 (kgf), centripetal acceleration = v² ÷ r (m/s²), period T = 2πr ÷ v (s). Validation: m, v and r must all be non-empty. Grading: no fixed tiers; F is proportional to the square of speed and inversely proportional to radius.
